### `Resources`

```csharp
Func<string, DefinitionResourceRequest, CancellationToken, Task<byte[]>> Resources { get; set; }
```

Supplies the bytes for a resource that has a `ref`. The reader never opens a path or fetches a URL on its own: `ref` is an opaque name the host resolves. Return null when the host has nothing under that name.
